digest.component_or_area: tests/external/live_jira_cloud_s3 - Jira Cloud reconciler integration testing
propositions: A new live test suite under tests/external/live_jira_cloud_s3/ exercises the reconciler against real Jira Cloud projects REB and DIG over an isolated S3-backed store in strictly read-only mode.
The suite structurally enforces read-only invariants by monkeypatching all 18 mutating AcliClient methods (create_issue, update_issue, add_comment, etc.) to raise JiraWriteForbidden.
Multi-project inbound fetch via compute_snapshot pulls both REB and DIG projects with real volume (2000+ issues total) into one S3 store with correct per-project attribution and scoping.
bridge_preview operates in DRY_RUN mode with per-project isolation and zero Jira mutations, verified by per-project issue count assertions before and after.
The throwaway S3 prefix (s3://<bucket>/<unique-prefix>) is isolated, used only as a git remote via git-remote-s3 with REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=off, and deleted on teardown.
Unknown project keys fail closed (raise) rather than silently succeeding, and the test suite is gated by REBAR_RUN_EXTERNAL and AWS credentials.
